reference: @remotion/transitions 4.0.537 and @remotion/player 4.0.537 Thumbnail, executed in Node with react-dom/server; implementation files were not opened
method: Each markup case renders the scene at one frame and keeps the composition markup inside the Thumbnail chrome. Only a digest of each render is kept (SHA-256 of the markup with numbers replaced by #, plus the numbers); replays compare the digest; numbers (opacity, transforms, polygon and path coordinates) match within absolute 1e-6. An {error} markup means the reference threw; the replay must throw too, with its own message. Timing cases compare getDurationInFrames and getProgress within 1e-6.
